verifications.claim: Reports from March 20, 2026 stated that Chuck Norris passed away at age 86.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R1 dated 2026/03/20: 'has died at 86'; R3 dated 2026/3/20: 'has died at the age of 86'; R4: 'has died at 86'
verifications.reasoning: Articles dated March 20, 2026 explicitly state death at age 86.

verifications.claim: Chuck Norris's family confirmed his death.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: All: family statement posted to social media/Instagram announcing death.
verifications.reasoning: Every source cites family statement confirming death.

verifications.claim: Chuck Norris's death occurred on Thursday, March 19, 2026.
verifications.label: VAGUE
verifications.evidence: All: 'Norris died Thursday'; R2: 'sudden passing ... yesterday (Thursday) morning'; articles dated March 20 implying Thursday=March 19.
verifications.reasoning: Sources confirm Thursday death with March 20 publication dates, logically March 19, but exact date 'March 19' not explicitly stated.

verifications.claim: Chuck Norris's death followed a medical emergency in Hawaii.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'admitted to hospital in Hawaii for a medical emergency'; R3: 'hospitalised in Hawaii since Thursday'
verifications.reasoning: Sources directly link hospitalization in Hawaii for medical emergency prior to death.

verifications.claim: Chuck Norris was surrounded by family at the time of his passing.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: All quote family: 'he was surrounded by his family and was at peace'
verifications.reasoning: Direct quote from family statement in every source.

verifications.claim: Chuck Norris's family is keeping the specific circumstances private.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: All quote family: 'While we would like to keep the circumstances private'
verifications.reasoning: Direct quote from family statement in every source.

verifications.claim: Chuck Norris's family described his passing as a "sudden passing".
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: All: family 'described as a “sudden passing”' or quote 'sudden passing'
verifications.reasoning: Exact phrasing from family statement quoted across sources.

verifications.claim: Tributes recognized Chuck Norris as a martial arts champion.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: tributes from Lundgren, Stallone; Texas gov: 'martial arts champion'; R3: Texas gov: 'martial arts champion'
verifications.reasoning: Tributes explicitly call him martial arts champion.

verifications.claim: Tributes recognized Chuck Norris as an action film star.
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2: 'martial artist and Hollywood movie star'; tributes from Lundgren, Stallone on action roles.
verifications.reasoning: Article title and tributes highlight him as action star.

verifications.claim: Tributes recognized Chuck Norris as "a devoted husband and a loving grandfather".
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: R2 family statement: 'To us, he was a devoted husband, a loving father and grandfather'
verifications.reasoning: Exact quote from family statement, presented as tribute.

verifications.claim: Chuck Norris starred in "Walker, Texas Ranger".
verifications.label: CLEAR
verifications.evidence: All: 'starred in “Walker, Texas Ranger”' or similar.

verifications.evidence: R1/R4: 'Black Belt magazine ... credited Norris ... with holding a 10th degree black belt'
